caption.size_rel: 0.055h, 1-3 words per card, thick black stroke

layout.host_pos: circular mask, upper-center, ~45% frame width, cutout on plain white/dark wall bg
layout.safe_zones: bottom 20% reserved for platform UI (like/share/comment rail on right edge implied, avoid placing text there); captions sit center-low under host circle
layout.caption_pos: center, ~60-65% down frame, single word/phrase per beat, swaps every ~1s

transitions: hard cut on every spoken word/phrase (word-synced caption swap)
host circle cross-fades to full-bleed diagram/screenshot and back
bg toggles dark<->light depending on inserted asset
